premises.text: The internet has become fragmented, requiring users to jump between multiple sites and apps.
premises.evidence_span: the rapid growth of the web scattered content across millions of websites, forcing us to jump site-to-site, assembling bits and pieces of information.

premises.text: VIRB can weave together services to provide a seamless experience for users.
premises.evidence_span: To reinvent surfing the internet on web or mobile by weaving together services you use.

premises.text: VIRB generates interactive cards from various services to provide information without leaving the page.
premises.evidence_span: VIRB generates a card from services like IMDB and Rotten Tomatoes and also provides me with direct links to these sources for more information.

premises.text: VIRB allows users to save and share their activity streams.
premises.evidence_span: I can review my decisions and I can also save this entire activity stream into a collection, which I can share publicly or in this case with just my team.

premises.text: VIRB syncs user activity and data across devices.
premises.evidence_span: VIRB syncs my activity and data across devices.

premises.text: VIRB integrates with other apps to provide comprehensive information.
premises.evidence_span: VIRB even deep links right into other apps on my phone, like Yelp, Foursquare, OpenTable, and Google Maps.

premises.text: VIRB uses data technologies like semantic search and recommendations to build contextual bridges across services.
premises.evidence_span: To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations.

value.text: VIRB reinvents how users surf the internet by providing a seamless and integrated experience.
value.evidence_span: we can finally bring back the magic of surfing, fluidly moving from link to link, service-to-service on any screen or device.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships were coded.
